description: Réseau de transport du Grand Dole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération du Grand Dole. Theoretical timetables of the Grandole Mobility Network (GTFS). Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération du Grand Dole. The portal shows the English title as "Grand Dole transport network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération du Grand Dole. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GTFS-RT, ZIP. The listing shows 2026-02-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
